text:
anya: Heads up — ran a seeded anchor cohort for model v3.1-int4 (anchored to v3.0) with a 2% traffic slice. Quick summary below.

sam: thanks — what popped out?

anya: short version: aggregate MRR delta = -0.7% vs v3.0, long-doc subset MRR = -1.8%. Latency p95 +12ms, p99 +35ms. Code-generation hallucination rate +0.4ppt (small n but notable). sample sizes: total ~1.2k requests, long-doc ~180, code prompts ~90.

kevin: how was the long-doc slice defined? any trimming rules?

anya: long-doc = requests where prompt_tokens > 2k OR response_tokens > 1k. No trimming applied for this run (we wanted realistic tail).

maria: are we inside our stoplight thresholds or do we need to block promotion?

anya: proposed stoplight (quick):

- GREEN: |delta MRR| < 0.3% AND latency p99 delta < 20ms AND hallucination_delta < 0.2ppt
- YELLOW: any metric outside GREEN but not hitting red thresholds (monitor, hold traffic growth, require 2 checks)
- RED: aggregate MRR drop > 1.0% OR long-doc MRR drop > 1.5% OR hallucination_delta > 0.5ppt OR latency p99 delta > 50ms -> auto-fallback

kevin: can you paste the rollout config snippet we'll actually use?

anya: sure, adding the rough YAML we'll put into gatebook:```
stoplight_policy:
  slices:
    - name: overall
      thresholds:
        mrr_drop_pct: 1.0   # red threshold
        mrr_warn_pct: 0.3   # yellow threshold
        latency_p99_ms: 50
        latency_warn_ms: 20
        hallucination_delta_pct: 0.5
        hallucination_warn_pct: 0.2
    - name: long-doc
      thresholds:
        mrr_drop_pct: 1.5
        mrr_warn_pct: 0.7
  actions:
    red: auto-fallback: v3.0
    yellow: throttle_traffic: true
    green: allow_promotion: true
```

sam: I think we should add slice-level strictness for long-doc and code snippets (code hallucination is more critical).

anya: agreed — implementing slice overrides for `code-snippet` with hallucination_drop_pct = 0.3 (warn) and 0.6 (red). Also adding a p-value check: if p < 0.05 on critical slices -> escalate.

kevin: propose quiet-burn behavior: if yellow for 2 consecutive checks, scale back to 0.5% traffic and run an extended 4h shadow, only then either re-attempt or rollback. avoids flip-flopping.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll add that to the runbook. Also will schedule a 30m sync after next telemetry dump. If auto-fallback triggers, we open a stub incident and tag #eng-ml + oncall.

anya: will push gatebook PR now and tag reviewers. PR will include the exact YAML and small smoke eval that runs every 15m during rollout.

rollout-bot: Canary start logged (id: canary-1815000000-v3.1-int4) -> 2% traffic. Snapshot: snap-20260401-3.1int4. Telemetry: https://dash.redwood.internal/canary/1815000000

sam: thanks — good plan. let's keep eyes on long-doc and code slices.

anya: yep. will post first 15m telemetry here when available.
